label: Qwen Code CLI
reason: Official Qwen Code docs describe hierarchical QWEN.md context and AGENTS.md compatibility. No sealed resolver revision exists. Not a public --reality. Not the Qwen model.

evidence.claim: Qwen Code CLI loads a project-root QWEN.md as committed team instructions.

Qwen Code CLI searches for the configured context file from the working directory through parent directories up to the project root identified by .git, or the user home. Home and ~/.qwen/ files are outside repository-only analysis.
If a repository already has AGENTS.md, Qwen Code CLI reads that file too.
The context file name defaults to QWEN.md and may be replaced via context.fileName. That substitution is not a sealed interpreter operation.
